1.title: As Xi Leaves Washington, Divisions Still Simmer Beneath the Surface
1.summary: President Trump welcomed Xi Jinping of China for a state visit that was heavy on pomp and ceremony. But surprisingly little time was spent on the issues that most divide the two superpowers.

2.title: Mississippi Hanging Was Staged After Drug Dispute, Investigators Say
2.summary: Tasia Fortune, 29, was found dead on Aug. 3, her body hanging from a tree branch behind an abandoned property in Jackson, Miss.

3.title: Black woman found hanging from tree was dead before body was 'staged' - US media
3.summary: Tasia Fortune's body was found hanging from a tree on the grounds of an abandoned home in Jackson in August.

4.title: Carney Seeks New Trade Partners for Canada, But Knows the Limits
4.summary: Canada’s prime minister is pursuing deeper trade, defense and cultural ties with China, India and the European Union, but none are likely to replace ties to the United States.

5.title: Russia targeting 'ordinary life' with attacks on Ukraine's data centres, Zelensky says
5.summary: Such strikes aim to disrupt "people's ability to stay connected, study, work", says Ukraine's president.

6.title: His Novel Had a Shot at a Top Book Prize. Then Someone Ran an A.I. Test.
6.summary: “It Was Either That Or Die,” by the Haitian-Canadian author Thélyson Orélien, was the hit of the French literary season. Now it has been pulled from the shortlist for a prestigious prize.
